details: JPMorgan Asset Management has expanded its institutional offerings by introducing two tokenized money market funds on the Solana blockchain. These funds are accessible to qualified U.S. investors via Morgan Money, marking a significant step in institutional adoption of the Solana ecosystem.
title: JPMorgan Launches Tokenized Funds on Solana

details: The crypto market experienced substantial liquidations, with over $404 million in crypto longs lost in four hours as Bitcoin briefly slipped below $80,000 on October 24. Total liquidations over 24 hours reached $815.26 million, impacting both Bitcoin and Ethereum. This downturn was exacerbated by significant net outflows from US spot Bitcoin ETFs, including a $635.5 million outflow on October 22 that erased prior inflows, alongside broader market weakness influenced by tech earnings and rising oil prices.
title: Crypto Market Sees Major Liquidations as Bitcoin Dips Below $80K
